about: Test policies Gemini found on colleges' own sites (Nov 2026). scripts/check-test-policy.mjs confirms each quote on its live page; only confirmed ones are added to data/test-policy.json. 'skipped' lists results left out and why.

skipped.california-state-university-northridge: Quote says scores are not required, but not that they are ignored; CSU policy is test-blind, so the federal label stays until a page says so.
skipped.mississippi-christian-university: Page covers the 2026 cycle, not fall 2027.
skipped.university-of-maryland-college-park: Source is the Universities at Shady Grove, not UMD admissions.
skipped.western-governors-university: Page says tests aren't required but not whether they are considered.
